items.title: GUAC main broadens IsDependency candidate production
items.summary: GUAC main can change the candidate set presented to the plant even though the checked IsDependency GraphQL schema is unchanged.
items.localContractImpact: Do not advance the GUAC pin from v1.1.0 without replaying the digest-pinned corpus through the declared GUAC contract, coordinate-normalization, CUE admission, and fresh-run determinism gates. Preserve GUAC/provenance/backend state as evidence-only.

observations.observation: commit fdaeed9a2d978e4286b87989ab3c12b9e30c3fc5 adds a CycloneDX 1.7 parser test whose expected ingest predicates contain a DIRECT IsDependency relationship, proving forecast candidate-production coverage can expand
the IsDependency GraphQL schema at main has the same Git blob SHA 8837ccd3adce68e19a3ad78831bd75250bfbfa2d as v1.1.0, so query-shape stability does not eliminate candidate-production drift

claims.text: Condition 1 — candidate set or identity: YES for candidate set under forecast inputs because GUAC main adds CycloneDX 1.7-to-IsDependency coverage; no change to stable identity for the existing digest-pinned subject corpus is established by this observation, and the IsDependency query schema remains byte-identical.

Condition 2 — semantic-authority leakage: NO in the current subject contract. GUAC candidates, provenance strings, backend IDs and ordering remain below pinned source declarations and CUE-qualified admission. Any future change that crosses this boundary is blocking even if upstream or local tests pass.

items.title: Gemara main changes the monitored evidence vocabulary
items.summary: Gemara main changes #Evidence and assessment-log constraints that feed CUE-qualified admission evidence.
items.localContractImpact: Keep Gemara v1.4.1 pinned. Any pin advance must re-specialize the imported vocabulary and pass bootstrap-check, vet, eval and qualify before the new evidence shape can participate in admission.

observations.observation: #Evidence at main adds optional source: #EvidenceMapping while retaining collected-at: #Datetime, changing an explicitly monitored pinned-external-semantic surface
main changes AssessmentLog.start from required to optional and adds #_AssessmentLogStrict to require start for executed result states; #Result values remain the same

claims.text: Gemara main is forecast evidence, not the subject's v1.4.1 vocabulary. Because the changed #Evidence/#Result-adjacent constraints feed gemara-evidence -> admission-policy -> cue-qualification, adoption is blocked on the declared CUE and experiment probes.

items.title: CUE master is not a linear successor of the pinned evaluator
items.summary: The required CUE forecast channel diverges from the v0.17.1 pinned commit and contains changes on cue vet/comprehension/reference-resolution surfaces.
items.localContractImpact: Do not substitute CUE master for v0.17.1. Resolve an explicit release-line candidate first, then rerun CUE source-closure qualification and fresh-run determinism before any promotion.

observations.observation: comparison of pinned fc6c0b2ecd3666da92f7053d13fcfbf009b7d7a3 to master f356f8f46cedb8e853ed200fb46ab49a68bfe357 is diverged: master is ahead 282 and behind 35 with merge base 9916719a3eb10e9a4c204af81e03076b799c124b
the compared forecast surface includes added/modified comprehension tests together with cue vet and reference-resolution test changes, directly intersecting the profile's admission-closure terms

claims.text: CUE master cannot be treated as 'the newer v0.17.1 evaluator' by ref recency. The semantic-validator node requires an explicit release-line candidate and executable requalification before its behavior can replace the pinned evaluator.
